name: we-design-agent
description: Org-level AI design agent for WheelsEye products. PMs and developers go from data, a hunch, or an existing screen to on-brand, DEV-READY Figma designs — composed only from the product's design system and gated by a review that actually runs. Sibling of we-mobile-dev-agent: same shared-skills + per-product-data architecture, aimed at design instead of code.

plugins.name: we-design
plugins.description: Figma design agent for WheelsEye products — PMs and developers go from data, a hunch, or an existing screen to on-brand, DEV-READY Figma designs built only from the product's design system. Multi-product registry (Loads + BookTruck FTL active; Operator/Consigner/Hulk/Install/Vylo/web onboardable via /onboard-system). 4 skills: /onboard-system (export → auto-built Figma variable/style foundations), /build-component (code component → variable-bound variant set), /screen-iterate (existing screen → faithful reproduction → change → dev-ready), /design-review (guardrail gate: adherence lint + dev-ready checklist + 3-lane compose/explore/adopt rule). Requires the Figma MCP connector with an edit-capable seat.
